en.title: What to Look for Before Choosing a Contract Manufacturer
en.description: A checklist for brand owners comparing contract manufacturers, from capability to communication.

sections.heading: Capability
paragraphs: Do they make your type of product regularly? Ask to see similar products and the machines used.

sections.heading: Documents
paragraphs: Ask for licenses and certificates, check the numbers and expiry dates, and ask how the factory handles your product registration documents.

sections.heading: Quality system
paragraphs: How are ingredients checked? How is each batch compared with the approved sample? Can they trace a batch?

sections.heading: Terms
paragraphs: Minimum order, sample rounds, lead time, payment terms, and who owns the formula. Get these in writing.

sections.heading: Communication
paragraphs: A good partner answers questions clearly, gives realistic timelines and tells you early when something changes. Visit the factory if you can.

id.title: Yang Perlu Diperhatikan Sebelum Memilih Pabrik Maklon
id.description: Daftar periksa untuk pemilik brand yang membandingkan pabrik maklon, dari kemampuan sampai komunikasi.

sections.heading: Kemampuan
paragraphs: Apakah mereka rutin membuat jenis produk Anda? Minta melihat produk serupa dan mesin yang dipakai.

sections.heading: Dokumen
paragraphs: Minta izin dan sertifikat, periksa nomor dan masa berlakunya, dan tanyakan bagaimana pabrik menangani dokumen pendaftaran produk Anda.

sections.heading: Sistem mutu
paragraphs: Bagaimana bahan baku diperiksa? Bagaimana setiap batch dibandingkan dengan sampel yang disetujui? Apakah batch bisa ditelusuri?

sections.heading: Ketentuan
paragraphs: Pesanan minimum, putaran sampel, waktu produksi, ketentuan pembayaran, dan siapa pemilik formula. Pastikan semuanya tertulis.

sections.heading: Komunikasi
paragraphs: Mitra yang baik menjawab pertanyaan dengan jelas, memberi jadwal yang realistis, dan memberi tahu lebih awal jika ada perubahan. Kunjungi pabriknya jika bisa.
